text: Implemented compressed ReducedRankGls execution for shared GLS fits. Added ReducedRankGlsPrepared: full-rank requests still delegate to GLS with ReducedRankGls engine identity; fixed compressed ranks prepare full-selection GLS once, derive a coefficient-space right-singular basis from the full GLS coefficient matrix, decode local coefficient blocks from that immutable basis, recompute whitened residual variance per block, and propagate coefficient covariance as voxelwise payloads. Future chunked execution now matches unchunked compressed ReducedRankGls from the same prepared basis. Voxelwise-AR compressed RRG remains an explicit unsupported boundary. Evidence: sbt fitJVM/test fitJS/test passed 124/119; final sbt modelJVM/test modelJS/test fitJVM/test fitJS/test passed 16/16/124/119; scoped git diff --check clean. Remaining: fmrireg lowrank/rrr fixture parity and fuller voxelwise-AR reduced-rank inference policy.
